description_en: Detaches a policy from a user or role
description_zh: 调用此API可以解除权限策略与用户或角色之间的授权关系
name: DeleteAbacAuthorization

parameters.help_en:
The type of object to which you want to attach the policy.********

Valid values:

USER
ROLE
parameters.help_zh: 授权对象类型，支持选择用户或自定义角色
parameters.name: identity_type

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the tenant.

To view the ID of the tenant, go to the Data Management (DMS) console and move the pointer over the profile picture in the upper-right corner. For more information, see the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181330.html section of the "Manage DMS tenants" topic
parameters.help_zh:
租户ID。
取自系统右上角头像处悬停展示的租户ID信息，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181330.html
parameters.name: tid

ErrorCode.description_en: The error code that is returned if the request failed

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message that is returned if the request failed

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. You can use the ID to query logs and troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 请求ID。用于定位日志，排查问题

Result.description_en: Indicates whether the policy is detached from the user
Result.description_zh: 是否成功解除授权人员与权限策略之间的关系

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

true: The request was successful.
false: The request failed
Success.description_zh:
请求是否成功，返回值说明如下：
true：请求成功。
